extraction.Name: Ellen Prue Packard
extraction.Refused/Protested: I was told by Gilbert Blacksmith, an Indian, that there was a patent for me at the Farmer's office in Okreek and I should come after it, but I told him that I did not want it. Then, if I remember correctly, my father later brought it to me.
extraction.Occupation/Income: I am teaching school at St. Francis.
extraction.NOTES: Allottee was supposed to get $7600 but received in cash about $5000.00; sale was made on the deferred payment plan but the last payment has not been made; she states she lost her home in the deal; she is not satisfied with the sale; does not remember signing a receipt; did not make application for the patent; has two children but only one is living; document sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, April 1st 1929; notary commission expires 4-28-32.
